name: Jingdezhen Handicraft Porcelain Industry Sites
description: Jingdezhen, in China's eastern Jiangxi province, has been called the "Porcelain Capital" for good reason. These five sites trace how porcelain was made here from the 10th to 19th centuries, from mined raw materials and evolving kilns to the Imperial Kiln beside civilian workshops. Its blue-and-white ware, made with a blend of kaolin and porcelain stone, became a prized export worldwide.
